author: agent:claude-code
message: The lesson from the relations batch: doc links read as uses.

title: Doc links counted as module uses
body: Measuring the relations from `crate::module` paths in the source, the first pass also read intra-doc links in comments (`[ArrayMath](crate::signal::ArrayMath)`, `[ForeignBuffer](crate::dlpack::ForeignBuffer)`) and reported layering cycles units <-> signal and signal <-> dlpack that the code doesn't have; that batch (01a109e6) was accepted, and 01a109e7 / this correction set it right. Lesson: strip comments before reading uses from source text, and check a surprising finding against the line it came from before proposing it.
